findings.evidence: grep `prod fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 1` finds Tate/MaximumModulus.lean:108 and Affinoid/MaximumModulus.lean:81. The `simp only [... one_pow, h1, mul_one]` calls are at Tate/MaximumModulus.lean:109, 128 and 135, plus Affinoid/MaximumModulus.lean:82. The only existing unit-radius lemma is `norm_coeff_le_one` (UnitBall.lean:91), which covers only the unit ball.
findings.fix: Add unit-polyradius lemmas in TateAlgebra/Basic.lean (e.g. `norm_coeff_le_norm : ‖coeff t f‖ ≤ ‖f‖` and an `∃ t, ‖coeff t f‖ = ‖f‖` form of `exists_achievesGaussNorm`) and use them at all four sites.
findings.issue: The helper `h1 : (t.prod fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 1` and the follow-up `simp only [one_pow, h1, mul_one]` are written by hand at lines 108/109, 128 and 135, and duplicated in Affinoid/MaximumModulus.lean:81-82. These sites strip the unit-radius weight off `norm_coeff_mul_prod_le` and `AchievesGaussNorm` each time.

findings.evidence: grep `Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos` finds MinimalPolynomial.lean:201 and Affinoid/MaximumModulus.lean:152, each preceded by the same `Nat.cast_sub i.2.le` cast lemma.
findings.fix: Add one lemma `a ^ (1 / (d - i : ℝ)) ≤ b ↔ a ≤ b ^ (d - i)` (for `i < d`, `0 ≤ a`, `0 ≤ b`) and use it at both sites.
findings.issue: The `hdi` cast plus `one_div, Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos ... (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.2), Real.rpow_natCast` chain repeats the same block in MinimalPolynomial.lean:194-202.

summary: The proofs are readable and well commented, with no undocumented defeq tricks. Two pieces of repeated reasoning should be factored into lemmas: the unit-radius Gauss-weight simplification (four sites in two files) and the rpow exponent conversion (copied from MinimalPolynomial).
